working_memory.text: A planning application to fill the disused Sedgely clay pit and build forty houses on the site has been deferred after a survey found great crested newts in two of the flooded workings. The developer must now submit a plan to move the newts to a new pond before the council will decide. Residents on the lane beside the pit had already objected to the extra traffic. The pit was worked for brick clay until the 1970s and has since filled with rainwater.
